experience.title: experience
experience.description:
I’m Yusuf Taiwo, a web systems builder focused on scalable websites, Notion architecture, and automation systems for creators, finance educators, and small businesses. I design practical digital infrastructure that turns strategy into repeatable execution.

As an official Notion Partner and Community Ambassador, I’ve built and shipped custom systems for 100+ businesses, startups, NGOs, and creators across Africa and beyond. I am based in Lagos, Nigeria, and collaborate globally on projects spanning product operations, workflow automation, and digital product delivery.

hard-skills.title: hard-skills
hard-skills.description:
Product strategy, project management, system architecture, and automation design. I specialize in Notion-based operating systems, no-code tools, and workflow automation that help teams centralize knowledge, improve accountability, and scale without unnecessary complexity.

I frequently collaborate with designers, developers, and stakeholders, turning abstract business needs into structured systems, clear documentation, and maintainable processes.

soft-skills.title: soft-skills
soft-skills.description: I bring a calm, structured leadership style to complex projects. I’m known for clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and the ability to align diverse teams around shared outcomes. I’m comfortable owning delivery, navigating ambiguity, and balancing speed with long-term quality.

bio.title: bio
bio.description:
I’m Yusuf Taiwo, a web systems builder helping creators, finance educators, and growing businesses ship better digital experiences. I build scalable websites, custom Notion workspaces, and automation systems that simplify operations and support long-term growth.

I’m an official Notion Partner and Community Ambassador, and I’ve delivered systems for 100+ businesses, startups, NGOs, and creator teams across Africa and beyond. Based in Lagos, Nigeria, I work at the intersection of design, systems thinking, and execution to build products people actually use.

interests.title: interests
interests.description: I’m interested in systems thinking, automation, product design, and the future of work. I enjoy exploring how structure, incentives, and tooling shape team behavior, culture, and scalability over time.

education.title: education
education.description:
My education combines formal training with extensive real-world experience. I studied at the University of Alberta, where I developed strong analytical and technical foundations, while continuing to learn through hands-on projects, partnerships, and professional practice.

This blend of academic grounding and practical execution shapes how I approach problem-solving, systems design, and leadership.

files.high-school: Early foundations in technology, analysis, and problem-solving.
files.university: University of Lagos — continuous learning through applied projects, research, and professional collaboration.

sports.title: sports
sports.description: I’m an active athlete — I run marathons, play football regularly, and swim frequently to stay fit and mentally sharp. These disciplines help me build endurance, discipline, and focus both on and off the field.

favorite-games.title: favorite-games
favorite-games.description: I’m passionate about strategic and analytical games. I’m a pro-level chess player and also enjoy Sudoku and complex puzzles — experiences that reward deep thinking, pattern recognition, and structured problem-solving.

1.title: CTG Method
1.description: A full ecosystem build for Certified Traders Group (CTG) — brand identity, merch design, an Academy platform redesign, and the launch of their Platinum membership tier.

2.title: Notion
2.description: Official Notion Partner & Community Ambassador. Designed and delivered custom Notion workspaces, templates, and automation systems for 100+ businesses, startups, NGOs, creators, and teams across Africa and beyond.

3.title: uncover
3.description: Uncover needed launch-ready visuals that could stay consistent across new African markets while still feeling local and human. I designed campaign assets, retail print materials, and digital content systems to communicate product benefits with clarity. The rollout strengthened brand recognition and gave the team a repeatable creative framework for expansion.

4.title: kaijego
4.description: Kaijego needed storytelling assets that could inspire travelers with lower-ranked passports while staying practical and brand-aligned. I built a narrative-driven visual system, editorial layouts, and campaign design around Alma Asinobi's global journey. The project elevated audience engagement and positioned Kaijego as both aspirational and actionable.

5.title: rroomfies Finance Tracker
5.description: A fully custom Notion-based Finance Tracker built for Jane Tsang (rroomfies) — including budgeting tools, savings goals, and a FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) planner. Sold directly to her 1M+ follower audience as a premium digital product.

6.title: maxx-improve-ecommerce
6.description: Maxx Improve needed a discreet, trustworthy storefront for a sensitive product category where clarity drives conversions. I designed and shipped a full Shopify experience, including UX structure, visual assets, and conversion-focused product communication. The result was a cleaner buying journey that improved customer trust and supported repeat sales.

7.title: sofit
7.description: Sofit needed structured digital products to convert high-engagement fitness content into usable everyday programs. I created branded workout guides, recipe content systems, and coaching resources optimized for clarity and motivation. This helped the brand launch stronger info products and deepen trust with its community.

8.title: pumpfiat
8.description: PumpFiat needed disciplined execution to move from early concept to a live, reliable B2B outreach platform. I led cross-functional delivery across product, design, and engineering to ship core workflows and align stakeholders around milestones. The launch created a stable operational base and supported measurable commercial growth.

9.title: maxx-improve-guides
9.description: Maxx Improve needed educational content that reduced confusion and helped customers use products safely and consistently. I designed a complete set of digital and print instructional guides with clear flows, dosage guidance, and visual explainers. The materials reduced support friction and improved the perceived quality of the product experience.

10.title: chess-notion
10.description: Chess players and coaches needed a single operating system instead of scattered notes, apps, and spreadsheets. I built modular Notion templates for study planning, game analysis, repertoire tracking, and performance reviews. The system made improvement loops more consistent and easier to sustain over time.

11.title: osof-notion
11.description: Creators needed premium, ready-to-use business systems without spending weeks building from scratch. I designed and packaged Notion templates, companion resources, and a cohesive digital product storefront for Osof Notion. The result was a scalable product ecosystem that supported both self-serve customers and custom client work.

12.title: compass-pdf
12.description: Travelers needed concise, actionable planning resources that cut through scattered online advice. I developed structured Compass PDF guides with curated routes, checklists, and destination-specific planning flows. The guides improved trip-prep clarity and made travel decisions faster for the target audience.
